summary.text: Barry Beauchamp is a Republican member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 38B who has served since September 10, 2024, and he is seeking election to a full term in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The owner and chief executive of Beauchamp Brothers Construction, he serves on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Barry Beauchamp attended James M. Bennett Senior High School in Salisbury, Maryland, and studied business administration and management at Salisbury University, according to his General Assembly biography.
He has been owner and CEO of Beauchamp Brothers Construction since 1985 and a licensed real estate agent since 1987.
Beauchamp has also served as a volunteer firefighter, EMT, engineer and assistant chief with the Salisbury City Fire Department.
Ballotpedia lists Beauchamp as appointed to the House of Delegates on August 19, 2024.
He has served on the Appropriations Committee since 2024 and in 2026 is on its Public Safety and Administration Subcommittee and its Racing and Sports Facilities Subcommittee.
Since 2024 he has also served on the Maryland State Board of Onsite Wastewater Professionals.
